sensor._comment: fov_x_deg IS PER SCENE. The render worker only uses an explicit fov_x_half_tan if one is sent; otherwise it falls back to the capture camera's intrinsics, so the policy's field of view is a property of the recording. Get the real number with: python3 -m splat_hitl.contract <scene>_nerfstudio/.../transforms.json

observation._comment: channels is the first thing to get right for an assignment: 'depth' for geometry-only navigation, 'rgb' or 'rgb_depth' for anything that has to SEE something -- a painted gate, an unknown-shaped gap. Per frame the channels are ordered [R, G, B, D] and frames stack along the channel axis, so history 4 of rgb_depth is (16, H, W).

action._comment: yaw_mode='fixed' is not a preference. splat_rl_env captures episode_basis at reset, never updates it, and holds yaw_policy_rad = 0.0 -- the policy has never seen the scene from any heading but its starting one.

control._comment: 15 Hz because control_dt_s = 1/15 in SplatEnvConfig. A double integrator run at 30 Hz produces twice the velocity per unit time, silently.

notes: EXAMPLE ONLY -- fov_x_deg below is a placeholder. Replace it per scene before flying anything.
_comment: The contract a policy assumes. Training and flight must load the SAME file; comparing `fingerprint` answers 'has this policy ever run under these conditions?' in one step. Generated from splat_hitl.contract.metric_splat_depth_ppo_v1().
